_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Pleyer Sineekaa kan gridi {width}×{height}.
Ati sineekaa {player_id} ni dhiheessi. Garaagarumman dhaban: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ykn w/s/a/d).
Madda: jiraatu guddaa kanatti ykn uumamaan guddaa ta'e ni too'annoo guddaa argati (xumura gara {max_turns} gara).

game_action.invalid_death: Bofa {player_id} sababa socho'iinsa hin taanee duute.

outcome.survived_win: Taphachiisaa {player_id} lubbuun hafe; warri kaan hundi ni du'an.
outcome.outlived: Taphachiisaan kun warra kaan hunda caalaa jiraateera.
outcome.turn_limit: Daangaa dabaree ga'eera - lakkoofsi gaariin mo'ata.
